python -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
# Expenses are in rows 11-22 (0-indexed 10-21), amounts in column C (index 2)
exp = df.iloc[10:22, 2].astype(float)
print('Expense items (Category col A is in index 0):')
for i, v in exp.items():
    print(f'  {df.iloc[i, 0]:<16} {df.iloc[i, 1]:<16} {v:>8.0f}')
print('Total Expenses (sum C11:C22):', exp.sum())
# Breakdown by category
grp = df.iloc[10:22, [0, 2]].groupby(0)[2].sum()
print()
print('By category:')
for cat, tot in grp.items():
    print(f'  {cat:<16} {tot:>8.0f}')
print('  {\"TOTAL\":<16} {exp.sum():>8.0f}'.format(exp=exp))
"
